title: Wednesday's peak in Lisbon: the airport forecast and IPMA's hourly model disagree
summary: The airport forecast (TAF, issued 23:00 Tuesday) has the strongest wind 09:00 to 16:00; IPMA's hourly model had it at 19:00 to 20:00. Our analysis (a hypothesis, labelled) widened the peak to 12:00 to 18:00. IPMA's warnings are what counts: red rain 09:00 to 18:00, unchanged; the wind warning was lowered by IPMA at 07:16:30 on Wednesday from red (12:00 to 21:00) to orange, 09:00 to 21:00, gusts up to 120 km/h (fact, row s-1111T0738).
closes: IPMA's station observations for Wednesday: the hour of the strongest gusts, measured. Not a forecast of ours.
